slots.headline: Why Choose Matcha?
slots.subtitle: The green tea that fuels calm energy and focus.

slots.title: Calm, Clean Energy
slots.body: Matcha delivers caffeine slowly thanks to L-theanine. No jitters, no crash—just steady focus. It’s the difference between a spark and a slow burn.

slots.title: Loaded With Antioxidants
slots.body: One cup packs more catechins than regular green tea. You drink the whole leaf, not just the brew. That means more nutrients in every sip.

slots.title: A Daily Mindful Ritual
slots.body: Whisking matcha slows you down for a moment. The routine becomes a meditation you can taste. Small rituals build better days.

slots.title: Boosts Your Metabolism
slots.body: EGCG helps your body burn calories naturally. It supports fat oxidation without stressing your system. Think of it as green fuel.

slots.title: Glow From Within
slots.body: Chlorophyll and antioxidants fight daily inflammation. Your skin reflects what you feed it. Clearer complexion, one cup at a time.

slots.title: Sustainable By Nature
slots.body: Shade-grown leaves require less water and space. One plant delivers multiple harvests per year. Good for you, better for the planet.
